params.name: Top bar button
params.tooltip:
How the minimap's button in the top-left bar looks. Text:
the word "Map" without a frame. Icon: a map icon on a dark
tile, like the game's data layers button.

params.name: View direction arrow
params.tooltip:
Show an arrow in the minimap's camera box that points where
the camera is looking.

params.name: Debug: performance log
params.tooltip:
Off: normal play. On: every 30 s, Better Minimap writes how
long its map builds, camera box updates and window renders
took to the game's log file (stdout.txt, lines starting with
[SQPERF]). Only for tracking down slowdowns; leave it Off
otherwise. Slow calls are always logged briefly, whatever
this setting.
